subject: URGENT: Production latency + 5xx spike - Zenith Payments
body:
--- Original message 1/7 ---
From: Amelia Chu <amelia.chu@zenithpayments.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Nadeem <samir@zenithpayments.com>, Zenith Payments SRE <sre@zenithpayments.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in latency and 5xxs on production endpoints (URGENT)

Rachel —

We started seeing a large spike in latency on your /generate and /embed endpoints around 08:50 PST (approx). Our transactions are timing out and we’re seeing ~6% 5xx rate and throughput backpressure; authorizations are queuing. Can you confirm whether this is on your side or an issue with our routing?

Impact: our payment authorizations pipeline shows ~2% drop in throughput over the past 20m; we can’t take it for much longer — this is affecting live customers.

Can you please escalate and provide a point of contact right away? Screenshots attached.

—Amelia
Amelia Chu
Head of Integrations, Zenith Payments
amelia.chu@zenithpayments.com

Attachments: latency_snapshot_0601.png

--- Reply 2/7 ---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Chu <amelia.chu@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Samir Nadeem <samir@zenithpayments.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency and 5xxs on production endpoints (URGENT)

Amelia —

Thank you for the heads up and the screenshots — I’m escalating now. I’m pulling in SRE and our engineering lead. We are opening a war-room and will provide minute-by-minute updates until we have stabilization.

Immediate steps we’re taking (next 30m):
- Triage with SRE to identify whether autoscaling or routing produced the surge.
- Validate model routing config and rollback any recent routing changes.
- Temporarily increase Dedicated capacity allocation for your account to mitigate backpressure.
- Capture detailed error logs and a Datadog link (sending below).

Point of contact: me (channel +1-415-555-0132, rachel.kim@redwood.com).
ETA for first technical update: 09:45 PST.

We’ve attached the initial Datadog snapshot and will follow up with logs. We understand the severity and are treating this as a P0.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Datadog dashboard: https://app.datadoghq.com/graph/zenith/abcd1234
Attachments: latency_snapshot_0601.png

--- Internal note 3/7 ---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production latency + 5xx spike - Zenith Payments

Team —

Labeling this P0 and requesting immediate exec awareness. Stephanie, we need your sign-off for emergency capacity burst and to authorize credits if needed. Diego, please prioritize triage (SRE ownership) and loop in any kernel/runtime folks if it looks like KV-cache or batching contention.

Please attach the mitigation runbook (I’ve included a high-level doc) and surface any blockers. I want a short executive summary for the customer within 30-45 mins, and a separate internal RCA timeline.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: mitigation_runbook.pdf

--- Internal tech 4/7 ---
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production latency + 5xx spike - Zenith Payments

Quick diagnostic: initial signals point to a regression in the autoscaler metric ingester introduced in a rollout earlier this morning (tagged by infra). The metric stream for pipeline_dispatch_lat (used by the autoscaler) had a semantic mismatch; the scaler did not scale as expected for short, high-concurrency bursts. That produced queue build-up and a subsequent spike in token-generation timeouts -> 5xx.

Mitigation applied at 10:05 PST:
- Forced scale-up of dedicated pools for Zenith by +25% capacity.
- Inserted a temporary fallback policy to route traffic to the previous routing group that uses a slightly larger model instance (higher throughput).
- Reverted the metric ingestion change in the staging branch and queued a hotfix to prod (rolling patch scheduled at 10:40 PST).

I’m attaching raw error logs for the time window (08:45–10:05). Looking for confirmation that latency is improving and noting any residual 5xx patterns.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: error_logs_0601.txt

--- Customer update 5/7 ---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Chu <amelia.chu@zenithpayments.com>, Samir Nadeem <samir@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency and 5xxs on production endpoints (URGENT)

Amelia / Samir —

Status update: we identified an autoscaler metric regression and have pushed a targeted mitigation. We forced a +25% capacity increase for your dedicated pool and routed transient traffic to a higher-throughput path. Early signals show latency trending back to normal and 5xx rates declining.

Next steps/action items:
- Engineering to roll the hotfix to production at 10:40 PST (Diego).
- We’ll run a verification window for 30 minutes post-rollout; if green we’ll keep the temporary routing for an additional 1 hour to ensure stability.
- Postmortem and timeline to follow by EOD.

We understand the impact and will provide a formal exec summary. If it helps, we can schedule a short bridge for your SRE and ours at 11:00 PST.

Again — apologies for the disruption. We’ll follow up with the hotfix result within 30–45 minutes.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--- Customer reply 6/7 ---
From: Samir Nadeem <samir@zenithpayments.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Amelia Chu <amelia.chu@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Zenith Payments SRE <sre@zenithpayments.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency and 5xxs on production endpoints (URGENT)

Thanks, Rachel. Appreciate the fast response. Please include details on:
- An incident credit for the window where throughput dropped (we’ll need SKUs and numbers).
- A written postmortem with root cause, remediation, and timeline.

Impact note: we lost several live authorizations during a key shopping window; this affected merchant revenue. We need daily briefings until postmortem is complete.

Samir
Samir Nadeem
Head of Payments Operations, Zenith Payments

--- Internal close/update 7/7 ---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-stabilization summary: Zenith P0 — actions and owners

Team —

Final status: hotfix rolled at 10:40 PST, verification window passed by 11:20 PST. Latency and 5xxs returned to baseline; throughput normalized. No additional customer-impacting incidents since.

Action items (owners & SLAs):
- Postmortem draft (RCA + timeline): Diego — due 2026-06-02 12:00 PST.
- Incident credit proposal (SKU-level exposure + suggested credit): Marissa — due 2026-06-02 09:00 PST.
- Exec summary for Zenith leadership: Marcus & Rachel — 2026-06-01 EOD (sent).
- Follow-up SRE bridge and preventative playbook: Stephanie — schedule for 2026-06-03 10:00 PST.

Customer comms: I sent an executive note and confirmed daily briefings until the postmortem is delivered. Marissa, please coordinate credits and contract impacts; keep legal looped if material.

Thanks for the rapid response. We’ll run the full RCA and propose long-term mitigations for the autoscaler metric pipeline.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
